content.text: In a digital landscape where platforms like Stripe and PayPal restrict access for creators in regions such as Nigeria and Venezuela, building an infrastructure that ensures [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-courses-pakistan-without-stripe-honest-side-side-8|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-beats-online-crypto-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-broken-here-infrastructure-2|Payment Infrastructure]]s-6|complete]] ownership becomes paramount. COREMERCH provides the tools to set up a fully operational crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, allowing you to bypass these limitations. This guide will walk you through deploying your store using Stack 02, ensuring you’re equipped to manage payments and digital product delivery seamlessly.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often lock out creators in underserved regions, creating barriers to accessing global markets. COREMERCH's infrastructure leverages Cloudflare's robust services, allowing you to build a store that thrives independently of these platforms. With full control over your data and payments, you circumvent the common issues of payment rejections and account freezes, ensuring a reliable commerce experience tailored to your needs.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To successfully deploy your crypto store, you need a Cloudflare account, access to Google Apps Script for backend logic, and a NOWPayments account for processing transactions. Familiarizing yourself with Supabase for order management will also be beneficial. Once you have these accounts set up, collect your digital products, ensuring they are ready for seamless delivery through Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Prepare your branding assets to create an appealing storefront.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by setting up your Cloudflare Pages project, ensuring your site is live and accessible. Next, configure Google Apps Script to handle your backend logic, linking it to Supabase for order storage. Integrate NOWPayments to facilitate crypto payments, ensuring you select low-fee networks like BSC or Solana. Test the payment flow with dummy transactions to confirm that your delivery mechanism works as intended, providing instant access to your products post-payment.
Build your store on Cloudflare Pages for unrivaled speed and reliability.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up and tested, it's time to go live. Promote your store through social media and digital marketing channels, leveraging your existing audience. Monitor the first transactions closely to ensure everything functions smoothly. Your infrastructure will automatically handle payments and product delivery, allowing you to focus on scaling your business. Gather feedback from your initial customers to refine and enhance their purchasing experience.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store operational, consider how to scale effectively. Use analytics to track product performance and customer engagement, adjusting your offerings based on demand. Expand your product line by adding more digital goods, and utilize Supabase to manage orders efficiently. Engage with your customers through newsletters or promotions to build loyalty. As your business grows, explore further integrations or additional tools within the COREMERCH ecosystem to enhance your operations.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
With COREMERCH, you own your infrastructure — no subscriptions, no dependencies.

Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host your digital product store on either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both platforms provide reliable hosting options, enabling you to showcase your products while managing backend functionalities using scripts.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 is a simpler setup using GitHub Pages and Apps Script, taking 4-6 hours for deployment. Stack 02, on the other hand, utilizes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, providing a more robust solution deployed in 48 hours.
How long does it take to deploy Stack 02?
Stack 02 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. This includes end-to-end testing to ensure your payment and delivery systems function seamlessly before you take control.
How do I integrate crypto payments into my store?
Integrating crypto payments involves setting up an account with NOWPayments, then configuring it within your backend logic to process transactions automatically when customers make purchases.
What support is available after deployment?
COREMERCH provides 30-day support after deployment to assist with any issues or questions you may encounter as you operate your store.
